question: 净利润最大的股票比净利润第二大的股票多多少元？

steps.description: Locate the stock with the highest net profit in the table and read its net profit from the previous year
Locate the stock with the second highest net profit in the table and read its net profit from the previous year
Subtract the net profit from step_2 from the net profit from step_1 to find the difference
